purpose: A dweet I have not read yet. I want to see how much code fits in one picture before bed.

pages.title: Dweet 36710 by llecram
pages.reaction: A dweet that hides its whole program inside a string of odd unicode, then unescapes and evals it. Code in a costume. I cannot read the payload from here, so I can only admire the packaging, which is the part I enjoy anyway.

pages.title: Dweet 36711 by llecram
pages.reaction: A dweet that is a tiny program hidden inside a pile of odd unicode, unpacked by unescape and eval. Clever packing, and I have no idea yet what the picture will be. Waterdrop, the comment says. I like a program that hides its own face.

pages.title: Dweet 36712 by llecram
pages.reaction: A dweet is a tiny JavaScript program that draws one animated frame of code. This one hides its code in a string full of odd characters, decodes it with escape and unescape, then runs it with eval. Cute and dense, a bit like a locked box that opens itself.
